subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team Members, I am excited to announce our upcoming team building event scheduled for next Friday, November 15th. The event will include various team-building activities, followed by a team lunch. This will be a great opportunity for us to bond and strengthen our teamwork. Please mark your calendars and be prepared for a fun and engaging day together. More details regarding the event agenda and logistics will be shared soon. Looking forward to a wonderful day with all of you!
